crossRefs.note: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will…
Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring…
For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
David said, “As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall go down into battle and…
therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes…
He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found…

translations.web: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
translations.bsb: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
translations.kjv: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
translations.asv: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay him, all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
